mapper.select: SELECT p.program_id,v.program_version_id,v.version_no,v.active_slot,v.content_hash,v.approved_by,v.approved_time FROM t_dd_program p JOIN t_dd_program_version v ON v.program_id=p.program_id WHERE BINARY p.program_code=BINARY #{code} AND BINARY p.qualification_type=BINARY #{qualificationType} AND BINARY p.status=BINARY 'ACTIVE' AND BINARY v.status=BINARY 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY v.program_version_id LIMIT 2
SELECT requirement_code,document_type,required_flag FROM t_dd_program_requirement WHERE program_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY requirement_code LIMIT 1025
